scope: One fresh Linux process per method; cached 18 × 18 / 128-mode profile; raw audio projection only.
method: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1; resource.ru_maxrss in KiB; excludes structural assembly/eigensolve, FIR, Blender and encoding. Other numerical work ran concurrently; times are indicative single runs.
benchmark_script:
import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import resource
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

root = Path('/home/maggi/Documents/spatial-sculptures')
sys.path[:0] = [str(root), str(root / 'src')]
config_module = importlib.import_module('prototypes.001_resonant_surface.dry.config')
model = importlib.import_module('prototypes.001_resonant_surface.dry.model')
config = config_module.load_config(root / 'prototypes/001_resonant_surface/dry/profiles/contact_200hz.json')
modes = model.get_modes(config, root / 'data/fem/001_resonant_surface')[0]
simulation = model.DryBasinSimulation(config, modes)
times = np.arange(96000) / 48000
started = time.perf_counter()
if sys.argv[1] == 'full_history':
    positions, velocities = simulation.trace(times)
    channels = simulation.pickup_velocities(velocities)
else:
    channels = simulation.pickup_trace(times)
elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
print(json.dumps({
    'method': sys.argv[1], 'mode_count': config.mode_count, 'observations': len(config.pickups),
    'duration_s': 2, 'sample_rate_hz': 48000, 'elapsed_projection_s': elapsed,
    'process_peak_rss_kib': resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
    'squared_velocity_sum': float(np.sum(channels**2)),
    'peak_velocity_m_per_s': np.max(np.abs(channels),axis=1).tolist(),
    'cache_key': modes.metadata['cache_key'], 'python': sys.version.split()[0], 'numpy': np.__version__,
    'source_sha256': {name: hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in
        ('src/spatial_sculptures/simulation/mode_bank.py', 'prototypes/001_resonant_surface/dry/model.py')},
}))
reproduction: Save benchmark_script to a temporary .py file, update its repository root, then run once with full_history and once with chunked.
